title: Updates
supporting: Backends, library backends and add-ons that have a newer version.

adminOnly.title: Updates are for administrators
adminOnly.body: Ask an administrator to look at what is out of date on this server.

loadError.title: Could not load the list of updates.

headline.loadError: Could not load the list of updates
headline.noneButFailed: No updates found, but the check failed for: {{sources}}
headline.noneButNever: No updates found, but not checked yet: {{sources}}
headline.unavailable: Updates cannot be checked on this server

source.label: Where updates come from
source.addonsUnreadable: the add-ons could not be read

disabled.title: Backend updates are turned off on this server.
disabled.body: The backends below are listed, but nothing can update them here. The server configuration turned backend installs off.

title.gallery: The backend gallery check failed, so backends may have updates that are not shown.
title.library: The library check failed, so library backends may have updates that are not shown.
title.addons: The add-on check failed, so add-ons may have updates that are not shown.

failedSource.lastGood: The list below is from the last good check, {{when}}. Reason: {{error}}.
failedSource.noGood: No check has worked yet. Reason: {{error}}.

row.unchanged: The update ended but the version did not change.
row.unconfirmed: The update ended, but no check could confirm it.
row.held: Held for approval. {{version}} asks for access that you have not approved ({{count}} new).

blocked.installsDisabled: Backend updates are turned off on this server.
blocked.incompatible: Version {{version}} cannot run on this host.
blocked.integrity: The library lists the installed version with different contents. Nothing was changed.

row.addonConfirm: Needs your confirmation in this browser
row.needsConfirm: {{name}} runs on nodes and needs your confirmation first. Use Update on its row.

check.throttled: A check ran moments ago. This is its result.

empty.title: Nothing to update yet
empty.body: Install a backend or an add-on and its updates show here.

dialog.title: Update ready
dialog.intro: Choose what to update. Each one is updated on its own, one after another, and counts as done only when a new check no longer lists it. A failure does not stop the others.
dialog.runningNote: Closing this window does not stop the updates.

node.noneBody: No update is listed for this backend on any node. It may be up to date everywhere, or it was just updated.
node.supporting_one: Version {{version}} is available. {{nodes}} have it installed, and {{count}} of them needs the update.
node.supporting_other: Version {{version}} is available. {{nodes}} have it installed, and {{count}} of them need the update.
node.supportingDrift_one: The nodes do not all have the same build. {{count}} of {{nodes}} differs from the cluster.
node.supportingDrift_other: The nodes do not all have the same build. {{count}} of {{nodes}} differ from the cluster.
node.warning: Updating stops the models that use this backend on each node. A model starts again when a request needs it.
node.driftNote: A node that differs from the cluster is not always behind: it can be newer. Updating puts it on the version the gallery offers.
node.intro: Each node stops the models that use {{backend}}, installs the new version, and starts a model again when a request needs it. This cannot be undone from here.
node.introMany: Each node stops the models that use these backends, installs the new versions, and starts a model again when a request needs it. This cannot be undone from here.
node.stopPartial_one: {{count}} model is recorded as stopping. On other nodes no model is recorded, and the record can miss one, so more models can stop.
node.stopPartial_other: {{count}} models are recorded as stopping. On other nodes no model is recorded, and the record can miss one, so more models can stop.
node.stopNone: No loaded model is recorded on these nodes. The record is not complete, so a model that uses this backend can still stop.
node.sequence: Nodes update one after another. This window shows each result when it ends.
node.confirmStopAtLeast_one: Update {{count}} node and stop at least {{models}}
node.confirmStopAtLeast_other: Update {{count}} nodes and stop at least {{models}}
node.runningNote: Stop keeps the nodes that have not started from starting.
